correctness.rationale: The counter update is exactly the number of preceding zero pairs on each appended one. Its coefficient sequence has least period m for odd m and 2m for even m, by the binomial-difference identity. Every product state is reached by charge-one cycles at zero residue two. Unequal trailing-one runs have a kill-and-calibrate suffix; other pairs have a two-level calibrated suffix, with a nonzero separation guaranteed by second finite differences. All states and the sink are thus Myhill–Nerode inequivalent, proving r*m*P+1. The actual checker passed 44 automata (14,226 states), 25,680 constructed pairwise witnesses and 98,292 direct word checks; these corroborate, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: A binary homopolymer cap is a natural constrained-source condition; modular scattered 001 counting is a concrete streaming statistic. The exact all-modulus, all-run-cap theorem determines required deterministic memory, establishes sharp saturation of a nontrivial product automaton, and identifies the even-modulus factor-two jump through an exact binomial-coefficient period. Its calibrated suffix lemma gives a structural and reusable reachability/observability argument; no extrapolation from finite enumeration or unmotivated arbitrary parameter slice is involved.
